title: Focus timer with uploaded assets
html:
A MOMENT OF FOCUS

One thing at a time.

Close the extra tabs. Take a breath. Make something good.

25:00
25 minutes, just for your next idea.
js: let remaining=1500;let interval=null;let deadline=0;const timer=document.getElementById('timer');const toggle=document.getElementById('toggle');const status=document.getElementById('status');function render(){timer.textContent=String(Math.floor(remaining/60)).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(remaining%60).padStart(2,'0')}function pause(){clearInterval(interval);interval=null;toggle.textContent='Continue focusing →'}toggle.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(interval){remaining=Math.max(0,Math.ceil((deadline-Date.now())/1000));pause();render();status.textContent='Paused. Your time is yours.';return}if(!remaining)remaining=1500;deadline=Date.now()+remaining*1000;toggle.textContent='Pause';status.textContent='One small step. You have got this.';interval=setInterval(()=>{remaining=Math.max(0,Math.ceil((deadline-Date.now())/1000));render();if(!remaining){pause();toggle.textContent='Start again →';status.textContent='Beautiful work. Time for a break.'}},250)});document.getElementById('reset').addEventListener('click',()=>{pause();remaining=1500;render();toggle.textContent='Start focusing →';status.textContent='25 minutes, just for your next idea.'});fetch("./assets/config.json").then(r=>{if(!r.ok)throw new Error("Asset unavailable");return r.json()}).then(data=>{document.getElementById("asset-status").textContent=data.message}).catch(()=>{document.getElementById("asset-status").textContent="Could not load the uploaded JSON asset."})
